entities.summary: Axel Hampus Dalström, was a Finnish architect. He was the director of the National Board of Public Building from 1869 to 1882. He is best known for the Old Student House in Helsinki, as well as seven lighthouses he designed in the 1870s.

entities.summary: Axel Hampus Dalström, was a Finnish architect. He was the director of the National Board of Public Building from 1869 to 1882. He is best known for the Old Student House in Helsinki, as well as seven lighthouses he designed in the 1870s.
